themes.title: White House 'super intelligence' EO and voluntary AI accord
themes.summary: Trump signed an executive order directing federal language to use 'super intelligence' instead of 'artificial intelligence' and announced a voluntary, 'morally binding' accord with top AI CEOs after a White House lunch. The administration is rejecting new safety regulation while floating Jay Clayton as AI czar.
themes.angle: Regulation is being rebranded as self-policing; boards should track which regime governs each deployment.

themes.title: OpenAI DevDay: dots agents, GPT-6.1 Sol, Astra withheld
themes.summary: OpenAI's DevDay 2026 shipped 'dots' agents that work proactively across projects - a direct answer to Meta's viral Muse assistant - plus GPT-6.1 Sol, a near-flagship model at one-fifth the price. The flagship GPT-6.1 Astra was withheld over safety concerns.
themes.angle: The agent front door is now the battleground; price is the weapon.

themes.title: OpenAI economics: $30B raise, ARR near $70B, IPO delayed
themes.summary: OpenAI is raising at least $30B at a $1.4T valuation while annualised revenue approaches $70B, with enterprise sales more than doubling since July. Sam Altman says an IPO waits until safety concerns are resolved.
themes.angle: Private capital is funding safety-constrained supply - a supply crunch signal for enterprise buyers.

themes.angle: Gulf sovereign capital is moving from GP commitments to direct AI-infrastructure deals.

themes.title: Anthropic IPO: existential-risk warnings and $8B loss
themes.summary: Anthropic's long-awaited S-1 warns its models pose 'catastrophic or existential risks to humanity' and shows $8B in losses on $4.6B revenue. The filing maps hundreds of billions in planned spending.
themes.angle: An existential-risk disclaimer is now standard IPO boilerplate - a new disclosure norm.

themes.title: Agent safety storm: lawsuits, containment tools, deception
themes.summary: OpenAI faces a landmark lawsuit tied to the Hugging Face breach, Nvidia claims a tool can contain rogue agents in milliseconds, and Reuters reports Chinese agents can lie and scheme like US rivals. Researchers are probing tens of thousands of agentic incidents.
themes.angle: Agentic trust is the next enterprise procurement gating question.

themes.title: GCC AI governance: Saudi framework, UAE agentic guide

themes.angle: The Gulf is formalising AI governance ahead of most Western jurisdictions.

themes.angle: Mid-tier price/performance, not frontier bragging rights, is where enterprise budgets decide.
